mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: Help people discover useful AI sources, tools, career opportunities and learning resources through clear listings and practical guides.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: Make AI exploration easier to understand, so people can choose tools, assess information and build useful skills with confidence.

values.title: Accuracy
values.description: Link to original sources, distinguish claims from evidence and correct identified errors.

values.title: Transparency
values.description: Clearly label affiliate links and sponsored content, and explain what a listing represents.

values.title: Accessibility
values.description: Use clear language, readable design and useful starting points for different experience levels.

values.title: Community
values.description: Welcome useful resources, questions and corrections from readers and builders.
